notes.title: Sequel in the works!
notes.content:
[h2]The story and spoilers![/h2][p]While [b]Tortuga[/b] ventures into the Blood Sphere to face Reydhelmaal, [b]Coconut[/b] embarks on his most important mission yet.

His [b]enchanted belt[/b], the source of his intelligence and humanity, is losing its power. To restore it, Coconut will venture into ancient ruins, forgotten temples, and forbidden shores, while uncovering a hidden plan: General, Reydhelmaal's mysterious right-hand man, is preparing a [b]demonic energy cannon[/b] capable of destroying the Sphere... and Tortuga along with it. Why is General so obsessed with destroying our turtle friend? What is his true identity?

Explore an [b]interconnected world full of secrets[/b], unlock [b]new abilities[/b], face [b]colossal enemies[/b], and solve the ultimate dilemma: [b]trust your friend or sacrifice him to save the island[/b]?

[b]Coconut Gaiden[/b] takes place before, during, and after the events of Trapers Platformer, this time from the point of view of the crocodile loved by all[/p][h2]
But what is the game like? Is it more of the same?[/h2][p]Trapers Platformer 2 revolves around the island of Montaña Clara and its inhabitants. But Coconut's journey is very different from Tortuga's, and so are his abilities and gameplay! Trapers Platformer 2 offers mechanics more in line with a classic Metroidvania. Abilities such as dashing, double jumping, diving, and many more allow Coconut to reach a ton of places that Tortuga couldn't. Plus, this sequel offers higher screen resolution and reworked menus.
[/p][h2]I want to know more![/h2][p]Great! Stay tuned for news, and follow my social media links. I'll be posting more exciting news soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375130/3403509d8f99d3b36684d9d99ccdc61f9ac968d1.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch notes Jun 24 2025
notes.content: Solved a bug where rhe player could get stuck in a particular platform

notes.title: Version 1.4.2
notes.content: - Fixed a physics bug that prevented the Rocker Ship multi-shoot to spread properly

notes.title: the New Game PLUS Update!
notes.content:
[h2]New stuff[/h2]
- New Game Plus added to the game
- New sidequest (only available on new game plus)
- You can now skip the game intro
- Some quality of life tweaks here and there
- Fixed a bug that caused high level monster to appear in the spring factory entrance for lower difficulties
- Fixed a moving platform in the spring factory area

[h2]How do I start a new game+?[/h2]
once you beat the game, you can restart any saved game as new game plus. Your weapons, powerups and maps will be preserved so you can keep growing stronger!

[h2]How do I enter the new sidequest zone?[/h2]
Once you start a new game plus, play as normal until you reach Treasure Island I. Go to the leftmost part of the island and a new building will be there. Inside you'll start your trip to the new area.

notes.title: Little fixes and tweaks released
notes.content:
Hi there! This is not a content update, but a little fixes and tweaks update based on your feedback.

Main changes include:
- Easy difficulty is now the default option for New Game
- Sound volume halved by default on first run
- Coin count shows up whenever you pick up coins
- First level rats aren't 5x as powerful as the orcs anymore!
- The forest boss fight can now be defeated with the base sword (you used to need at least one sword upgrade) 
- Lots of small dialogue placement tweaks

This update includes a lot of little fixes which I believe would be nice to have before the next big update (NG+ and the new NG+ dungeon). Let me know if any bug slipped in, and thanks for your support!

notes.title: v1.3.0 The difficulty modes update!
notes.content:
[h2]Difficulty Settings Update is here![/h2]
Hello there! This update brings difficulty options to Trapers Platformer! The game is supposed to be challenging indeed, but if the bosses or jumps get too infuriating for you, there are not one, but TWO easier game modes to try! And if you are into suffering and pain there's a harder game mode too! Yay!

So if you got frustrated in the past, don't be ashamed to start over and enjoy the charming story behind Trapers Platformer. The difficulty selection screen is available when you start a new game, and your existing saves will be labelled as "classic" difficulty.

[h3]So what's next?[/h3]
V1.4.0 Will be the last content update, and will feature the long awaited new game+! Keep an eye on the news for updates on this matter ;)

[h3]Hey! I Found a bug![/h3]
Something not working as expected? Or perhaps you still find the game too hard? Don't be afraid to report whatever you find! Your feedback makes the game better.

notes.title: Tweaks and fixes
notes.content:
Hi there! This version is a bunch of small tweaks and fixes ahead on the next big one. Some things include:
- The first boss was still moving during pause
- Some graphical glitches here and there
- Better background contrast in the cursed tower
- Added a save point right after the first boss
- Starting a new game after playing an existing one was carrying playtime and coins!

notes.title: The quality of life stuff upgrade!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Audio volume can now be configured from the settings menu
[*] Use Gamepad L/R or PgUp/PgDn to switch weapons
[*] Some minor tweaks on the forst tweak to make it easier to find the buildings and optional powerups
[/list]
